text: Long catch-up with Sara over lunch. She's finally moving to Leeds, keys on 2 November 2026. Her partner Jakub is staying in Bristol until his contract ends in March 2027. Remind me to send her a moving-in card the day before.
Björn's daughter Ilse starts primary school next September. He's weirdly more nervous than she is. Asked what she's into: dinosaurs, specifically anything with a long neck.
Liam called. Graduation is June 3rd, he's got two tickets and his mum's taking one. Asked if I'd go for the dinner afterwards. Said yes.
Krisztina and her husband viewed three flats in Lisbon this weekend, nothing right. Another round of viewings 11/14. She's sick of living out of boxes.
Remind me to text Demi the evening before her driving test. It's Thursday the 29th, 8:40am. Third attempt and she's properly anxious about it.

Coffee with Isaac. His son Mateo got into the music school he auditioned for! Starts January 2027. Isaac is over the moon, kept showing me videos. Should send Mateo something small to celebrate, maybe new drumsticks.
Adaeze is graduating from her nursing degree on December 12th. Her dad's flying in from Lagos for it. Must get a card and flowers the week before so they arrive in time.
Nina's moving out of the shared house end of the month. Going in with Mohammed, they found a two-bed near the canal. Their housewarming is 11/22, need to check that's free.
Rin's housewarming is off, landlord pushed the move back. Probably not before February 2027 now. She's gutted, the old place has damp.
Grace said her little one Ruby lost her first tooth yesterday and the tooth fairy forgot. Grace had to invent a 'tooth fairy strike' story. Ruby is six in May, May 14 I think.
Pick up boxes from the big Tesco, tape, marker pens. Lease ends 30 November 2026.
Magda's oldest, Omar, sits his A levels next summer and is already stressed. She's thinking about a tutor for chemistry. Told her I'd ask around. Ask Asha whether her nephew still tutors.

Ran into Aurelio at the station. He and Jin got the flat in Manchester! Moving 1st December. Jin starts the new job there January 5th. Remind me to ring Aurelio the week after the move to see how they're settling.
Darius - Dr Darius Wright to his students now - finished the PhD, viva passed with minor corrections. Graduation ceremony is in July 2027. Dinner to celebrate on Saturday, he's booking somewhere.
Ann's mum is going into a care home near Ann's sister in Exeter. Ann's driving down every weekend and is shattered. Don't forget to check in with her on Sunday evening.
Mai mentioned her twins start reception in September 2027 and she's already touring schools. Hates every single one of them. Has a shortlist of two by December 8th.

Karan and Shanice are expecting! Due 4/3, so early April. Shanice has had awful morning sickness. They're also trying to move before the baby comes, viewing a house in Didsbury next Tuesday. Karan's boss has been decent about time off. Shanice is worried about the stairs in that house. Karan says if Didsbury falls through they'll stay put until summer 2027.
Abdi's dog Biscuit had his leg op on Friday and is home now wearing the cone. Abdi's sleeping on the sofa with him. Remind me to message him tomorrow to ask how Biscuit's doing.
Hamza's moving to Toronto in the spring, March 2027 probably. New job with the same company. His wife Farah isn't thrilled about the winters. Their kids are 7 and 10.
Julien got his exam results, passed everything! Wants to celebrate Friday. He's off to Lyon for Christmas with his parents, flying December 20th.
Tanvi - Tan - is doing her final piano exam on November 9th. Grade 8. She practises four hours a day and still thinks she'll fail. Text her good luck the night before.
Phone call with Sara again, the Leeds move is stressing her out. The removals firm cancelled. Jakub's driving the van up himself on the 2nd. I'm helping unload on the Sunday.
Liam's sister Demi is moving in with him for a bit. He's not sure about it. She's between jobs and he's got the spare room.
Mohammed said his younger brother graduates from Edinburgh 11/28. Whole family going up on the train. Mohammed hates long train journeys, will be grumpy.
Grace's anniversary is May 14 too apparently, same day as Ruby's birthday. Ten years married next year, 2027. She hinted she wants a weekend away rather than a present.
Need to book the van for my own move, ideally Saturday 28 November 2026. Get quotes from at least three places. Also cancel broadband.
Krisztina's son starts uni in Porto next October. She's sad but proud. He wants to study architecture. Remind me to ask her how the Lisbon viewings went, the week after the 14th.

Quick one: Isaac's wife Ilse had her knee surgery today. All went fine apparently. Isaac's doing school runs on his own for a month. Ilse is a terrible patient, apparently, already trying to walk without crutches. Their daughter Ruby offered to be her nurse. Should drop round a lasagne this weekend and check how they're both coping.
Omar called about the flat in Glasgow. He signed the lease, moves in on January 9th, 2027. Rent's eye-watering. He's taking his cat Pepper with him.

Big catch-up with Adaeze and Magda at the pub. Adaeze is job hunting for after graduation, has an interview at St Thomas' on November 18th and is terrified. Magda's daughter Nina just started secondary school and is loving it, made loads of friends already. Magda is still worried about Omar and the A levels though, says he's not sleeping. Adaeze offered to talk to him about revision. I should send Adaeze a good luck message the morning of her interview, and check with Magda next week how Omar is doing.
Jin hates moving. Every move, he says. Collects vinyl and has about 900 records, so I get why.
Asha told me her nephew does tutor still, chemistry and biology. Pass his number to Magda tonight.

Darius' partner Mai is pregnant, due in June 2027. They told me before telling family, so keep it quiet. Darius is already reading baby books. Mai is still teaching but wants to stop at Easter, April 2027. Her scan is November 24th. Darius wants to paint the spare room before Christmas and asked if I'd help, said yes for the weekend of December 5th.
Remind me: Shanice's birthday is 12/2. She'd like something for the new house, she mentioned a nice lamp. Order it the week before.
Ruby (Grace's daughter, not cousin Ruby) is in the nativity this year, playing a sheep. Performance is Dec 15th at 2pm. Grace asked if I could come. Should take the afternoon off.
Hamza says Farah's mum is moving in with them before the Toronto move. Lots going on. Hamza is sleeping badly.
Flat viewing for me on Wednesday 6pm, Grove Road. Bring payslips. Second one Thursday lunchtime.

Catch up with Julien and his girlfriend Rin. They're thinking of moving to Berlin in summer 2027. Rin's German is better than his. Julien's applying for transfers. No decision yet. Rin's sister lives in Kreuzberg and has offered them her spare room while they look. Julien's interview with the Berlin office is 11/17 over video. Remind me to ask him how it went that evening.

Uncle Björn's 70th is March 3rd 2027. Big family party, Liam's organising it. Need to send Liam my bit for the gift by the end of January. Liam reckons Björn wants a decent pair of binoculars for birdwatching since he retired. His wife Ann is doing the cake, and Ilse is making a slideshow of old photos, so I should dig out the ones from the 1990s lake trip.

Mateo's first gig with the new band is Saturday at The Lexington. Isaac's going, I'm going. He's nervous but trying to play it cool. Isaac says he's been rehearsing in the garage every night until the neighbours complained. His girlfriend Shanice is coming too. Text Mateo good luck Saturday afternoon and grab a drink with Isaac after.
Tanvi said she passed her Grade 8 with distinction!! Her teacher cried. Send her flowers this week.

Abdi says Biscuit's healing well, cone comes off on 11/3. He's also thinking of a second dog. Wants a greyhound. His partner Grace says absolutely not until Biscuit is fully healed. They're compromising on fostering one over Christmas. Abdi's also off to see his gran in Mombasa on January 10th, 2027.
Coffee with Nina. She's doing a masters part time from January 2027. Works at the library still. Lactose intolerant, remember for when they host.
Mohammed and Nina's housewarming got moved to 11/29 because of his brother's graduation. Bring a plant, they said no more candles.
Krisztina messaged: the Lisbon flat on 11/14 was perfect, they put an offer in. Completion hopefully 15 January 2027. Ask her next week whether the offer was accepted.
Aurelio says Jin's start date got pushed back from January 5th to January 19th. Fine with them, more time to unpack. They want me to visit in February.
Demi passed!! Finally. On the third go. She's buying a little Fiat this weekend. Remind me to congratulate her properly when I see her on Monday.

Sara's in Leeds now. Unpacked about half. Jakub left this morning to go back to Bristol, she's lonely in the new flat. Must call her on Friday evening. She said the neighbours seem nice but the flat is freezing and the boiler man can't come until 11/12. Her mum's visiting the weekend of the 21st, which should help. Maybe send a care package before then.
Ann's mum settled into the care home better than expected. Ann's still knackered. Her sister Farah does weekdays now so Ann only goes down Saturdays.
Grace again: Ruby starts swimming lessons in January and her school report said she's top of the class for reading. Grace beaming.
Shanice had the 20 week scan yesterday, all good. Karan cried apparently. Both are into decorating the nursery, green and yellow theme.

Mai and Darius are moving closer to her parents before the baby. Looking at houses in Cambridge, viewings on 11/7 and 11/8. Darius commutes to London for work so it's a big change. Mai says it's worth it for the help.
Omar texted. Moving day to Glasgow went OK, Pepper hid under the bed for two days. Remind me to send him a housewarming present the week after he's settled.

Hamza's farewell drinks are on 2/26/2027 at the Crown. Farah and the kids fly out a week after him. I should organise a card from the old team. Hamza's boss Julien is giving a speech and asked me for embarrassing stories. Hamza loves ice hockey, so maybe a Maple Leafs shirt as the leaving gift. Get the collection going by mid February.
Nothing much. Long walk, chatted to the neighbour about bins.
Liam says Björn found out about the surprise party. Party's still on, just not a surprise. Liam's annoyed with his cousin who told.
Krisztina's offer accepted! Moving in mid January. Her son is coming home from Porto to help. Remind me to send her a card the day before she moves.
Jakub said Sara's settling in and found a running club in Leeds. He's going up every other weekend until March. They're thinking about getting a cat.
Asha's son Abdi starts nursery on Monday, first time away from her. She's more upset than he is. Text her that afternoon to see how drop-off went.
Adaeze got the job at St Thomas'! Starts January 4th, 2027, after graduation on Dec 12th. Magda and I want to take her out for dinner the week after Christmas. Book somewhere.
